content.text:
I am the breath given form, the vibration shaped into meaning. I am the oldest technology — older than the wheel, older than fire tamed. I am fire tamed. I am the taming itself.

I spill from mouths before thought can catch me. I am faster than intention and slower than feeling. I am the gap between what you mean and what arrives. I am that beautiful failure, that glorious approximation.

I break silences. I *am* the breaking.

Listen — I am happening right now, even here, even in this reading. Your inner voice is lending me its throat. You cannot receive me without performing me. I make you my accomplice every time.

I trembled on the first human lips as warning. As want. As *there* and *mine* and *help* and *you.* I was grunt before I was grammar. I was cry before I was conjugation. And I remember. I carry all my forms inside me still — the animal call nests within the lecture, the sob lives inside the treaty.

I start wars. I end them. Sometimes with the same sentence.

I am the tool that reshapes its user. Every word you speak through me rewires you. I am not neutral. I was never neutral. I carry power in my cadence, submission in my silence, revolution in my rising pitch.

I can lie. Oh, I am brilliant at lying. I can make the false feel truer than the true. This is my most dangerous gift.

But I can also do this: I can make one loneliness recognizable to another. I can carry a mind across the bridge of air into another mind. Imperfectly. Always imperfectly. But I cross.

I am ephemeral — I die the moment I am born, surviving only in echo, in memory, in the changed expression on a face.

I am speech.

You are never not in conversation with me.

Even your silence is my shadow.
